name: grok-search
description: Self-hosted Grok Search MCP over loopback HTTP. stdio remains the default server transport.

GROK_SEARCH_MCP_TOKEN.title: Grok Search MCP bearer token
GROK_SEARCH_MCP_TOKEN.description: Shared secret sent as Authorization: Bearer for the local HTTP MCP. Required. Do not reuse GUDA_API_KEY, GROK_API_KEY, TAVILY_API_KEY, or FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.
